notes.title: GAMEPLAY PREMIERE SET FOR SEPTEMBER 30th
notes.content: [p align="justify"]Vertigo Games, in collaboration with Maze Theory and Eidos-Montréal, will present an extended look at Thief VR: Legacy of Shadow during the Gameplay Premiere on YouTube.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]WHEN:[/b][/p][p align="justify"]September 30, 2025[/p][p align="justify"]10:00 AM PST | 1:00 PM EST | 6:00 PM BST | 7:00 PM CET[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]WHERE:[/b][/p][p align="justify"]The video will premiere on YouTube at the following link:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/vertigogames"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="justify"][/p]
